# Remote Control Agent v0.1.41 — Credential-isolated Session transport

- Spec [#62](https://github.com/lirtual/github-actions/issues/62) follow-up: the GitHub-hosted Ubuntu/Windows Session Agent separates the one-shot GitHub OIDC registration from the long-running WSS transport process. The credential-bearing registration process exits after verified Ed25519 identity recovery and starts the single job-scoped Agent with an allowlisted nonsecret Runner environment.
- The long-lived child retains the exact GitHub Run/Attempt, RUNNER_TRACKING_ID, private Session identity and supported file/Shell/receipt engine, but does not inherit OIDC request tokens, arbitrary repository variables, secrets or NODE_OPTIONS. Ordinary permanent/manual pairing is unchanged.
- Companion [Worker PR #643](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/pull/643) adds the Session physical-Attempt revocation fence, which must be deployed first using the existing protected manual GitHub Actions release. The already published github-actions Session workflow still pins Agent v0.1.40 until Owner-approved SHA/tag variable updates.
- Three-platform unpublished candidate [Agent CI #41207955984](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/actions/runs/41207955984) succeeded on Linux x64/ARM64 and native Windows x64. All three artifacts were independently downloaded and SHA-256 checked against CI SHA256SUMS and package manifests/Session entrypoints. The candidate is retained only until 2026-11-02 UTC.
- **No production deployment, device upgrade, workflow pin change or new physical E2E is part of creating this Draft candidate.** A reviewed Agent Release pin merge automatically publishes; it requires separate Owner production approval, then genuine Ubuntu+Windows Session WSS/Shell/file/Stop/expiry and credential-free handoff verification. A controlled WSS-only disconnect/reconnect stress path remains unverified.

Source: [Agent PR #82](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/82) (merged source SHA 9fecb3d8e376095d39cb0709c4f27d197b8c7df7).
